description: A blank panel in a colour of your choosing, resized by dragging either edge, which can also display text for streaming or video work
notes: drag either side edge of the panel to change its width
the panel carries no text until Draw text: is ticked in the Text Overlay menu, and the words come from Input text or from a .txt file loaded there
menu: Chroma: sets the panel colour with red, green and blue sliders, and Use plugin panel colour returns it to the plugin default
Set as default width keeps the current width for new instances
Bypass Room Brightness keeps the panel at full brightness when the room is dimmed
Draw text: switches the text overlay on, and Input text opens a field to type or paste what it shows
Load file lists the .txt files in the Chromakey folder of the Rack user directory and puts one on the panel
Watch file reloads the text when the file on disk changes, and Tail mode shows the end of it
Text position:, Font:, Font size and Colour: set how the overlay is drawn, and Autoscroll moves it at a set speed after a delay
Generate Patchlist writes the names of the patches in the Rack user directory to a text file and shows it on the panel
Save current text as... writes what the panel is showing to a .txt file in the Chromakey folder of the Rack user directory
